results.name: Wildfires in Guatemala
results.reason: On 24 May 2024, multiple wildfires are affecting forest and non-forest areas in northern Guatemala, including Peten, Alta Verapaz, Quiche and Huehuetenango. A severe crisis due to these widespread fires has been reported. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, fire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
